D.t: Jimmy Panetta leads by 52.7 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 139,200 votes; a one point swing is about 1,320 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +46.5 and D +58.7. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$5.5M cash against $7K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
